answer: In an agent marketplace trading yarrow seeds, plume grass, and nectar, dispute votes are weighted by tokens locked in escrow for 30 days, rather than by account count. Splitting 100 tokens among a thousand fake agents still buys only 100 tokens of voting power. To dominate a vote, an attacker must acquire and lock more tokens than the honest voters combined, tying up capital and risking losses if the token price falls.
